summary.tldr: Implements tax and other measures from the 2023 fall economic statement and the 2023 budget, including new business, digital services, and credit rules.
what_it_does: Limits how much interest and financing costs certain corporations and trusts can deduct, and adds rules for hybrid mismatch payments and some partnership and foreign income items.
Creates new tax credit rules for carbon capture, utilisation and storage and clean technology, and adds wage and apprenticeship rules for some claims at regular tax credit rates.
Changes rules for employee ownership trusts, intergenerational business transfers, and certain loans and debts used in qualifying business transfers.
Changes First Home Savings Account rules, including excess amount, swap transaction, and reporting rules.
Adds a 2% tax on certain share buybacks by covered entities and creates a 3% digital services tax on taxable Canadian digital services revenue.
Sets special filing, payment, bankruptcy, receivership, penalty, audit, assessment, and collection rules for the new digital services tax and related parts.
who_it_affects: Businesses using carbon capture or clean technology credits
summary.background: The bill implements certain measures from the fall economic statement tabled on November 21, 2023, and certain measures from the budget tabled on March 28, 2023.
